name: Cleaving Strike
description: A heavy weapon strike from an elite/boss Skeleton Guard, hitting far harder than its usual blows.

name: Sweeping Cleave
description: Swings its weapon across the whole party, spreading the damage thin across every target.

name: Finishing Blow
description: Charges for 1 turn, telegraphing its target, then delivers a devastating strike meant to fell all but the sturdiest fighters.

name: Crush
description: Moderate damage, also weakens the target's defense for a few turns.

name: Venomous Bite
description: A heavy fanged bite from an elite/boss Giant Spider, hitting far harder than its usual bites.

name: Web Barrage
description: Sprays webbing across the whole party, spreading the damage thin across every target.

name: Death Bite
description: Charges for 1 turn, telegraphing its target, then delivers a devastating bite meant to fell all but the sturdiest fighters.

name: Web Trap
description: Moderate damage, also poisons the target.

name: Claw Rake
description: A heavy claw strike from an elite/boss Dragon, hitting far harder than its usual attacks.

name: Fire Breath
description: Breathes fire across the whole party, spreading the damage thin across every target.

name: Inferno Bite
description: Charges for 1 turn, telegraphing its target, then delivers a devastating bite meant to fell all but the sturdiest fighters.

name: Scorching Breath
description: Moderate damage, also sets the target on fire.

name: Rusted Blade
description: A heavy blade strike from an elite/boss Zombie Knight, hitting far harder than its usual swings.

name: Rotting Swing
description: Swings its blade across the whole party, spreading the damage thin across every target.

name: Grave Judgment
description: Charges for 1 turn, telegraphing its target, then delivers a devastating strike meant to fell all but the sturdiest fighters.

name: Diseased Strike
description: Moderate damage, also weakens the target's defense for a few turns.

name: Shadow Slash
description: A heavy blade strike from an elite/boss Dark Knight, hitting far harder than its usual strikes.

name: Dark Wave
description: Unleashes a wave of dark energy across the whole party, spreading the damage thin across every target.

name: Abyssal Judgment
description: Charges for 1 turn, telegraphing its target, then delivers a devastating strike meant to fell all but the sturdiest fighters.

name: Crushing Blow
description: Moderate damage, also stuns the target.

name: Bite
description: A gnawing bite, dealing slightly more damage than a plain scratch.

name: Blood Drain
description: Drains blood from the target, dealing damage and healing itself for half of it.

name: Acid Spit
description: Spits corrosive acid, damaging and possibly corroding the target's armor.

name: Bone Throw
description: Throws a sharpened bone at the target, ranged damage.

name: Regeneration
description: Rotting flesh knits back together, restoring HP.

name: Poison Bite
description: A venomous bite, dealing damage and possibly poisoning the target.

name: Quick Bite
description: A fast snapping bite, dealing slightly more damage than a plain scratch.

name: Web Spit
description: Sprays sticky webbing at the target, damaging and possibly slowing it down.

name: Arrow Shot
description: Fires an arrow at the target, ranged damage.

name: Guard Stance
description: Raises its shield into a defensive stance, boosting its own defense.

name: Paid In Full
description: A heavy single-target blow from the boss form of What's Left of Him, hitting far harder than its usual strikes.

name: The Same Price
description: Hits the whole party at once, spreading a lighter share of damage to each — whatever it charges, it charges everyone the same.

name: Everything You Asked For
description: Charges for 1 turn, telegraphing its target, then delivers a devastating strike meant to fell all but the sturdiest fighters.

name: What's Left Listening
description: Moderate damage, also blinds the target — something in the room answers back, and it isn't the target's own eyes anymore.

name: Whispered Name
description: Says something under its breath that isn't meant for anyone living, and the air goes wrong where it lands.

name: Grave Chill
description: Reaches through cloth and mail alike, and leaves whatever it touched slower to close its guard again.

name: Ember Lash
description: Flicks a whip of live coal across the dark; whatever it catches keeps burning after it has gone.

name: Settle Into Stone
description: Stops moving entirely, the way it must have stood for years before anyone came down this far.

name: Bone Breaker
description: Brings its whole weight down through the shoulder, aiming for what holds a guard up rather than what it protects.

name: Maul
description: Takes hold with both paws and worries at what it has caught until something opens and stays open.

name: Skullsplitter
description: Swings the heavy end of its weapon in a single downward arc, put where a helmet meets a neck.

name: Rout
description: Turns on the spot with its arms out wide, driving everyone in reach back a pace at once.

name: Helm Crusher
description: A flat, ringing blow to the head — the target is still upright, but nothing gets through to them for a while.

name: The Last Trophy
description: Winds up slowly and unmistakably, watching one of them the whole time, then brings it all down.

name: Crimson Talon
description: One long nail opens a line where the armour gaps, unhurried, almost fastidious.

name: Scarlet Mist
description: Bursts apart into a fine red haze that passes over the whole party and gathers again behind them.

name: Opened Vein
description: Finds the vessel it wants on the first try and leaves it running.

name: Final Draught
description: Holds still, choosing, then closes the distance all at once on the one it has been watching.

name: Grasping Remnant
description: A limb that used to belong to something else reaches out of the mass and takes hold.

name: Unravelling Tide
description: Spills outward in every direction, and everything it washes over comes back a little less whole.

name: Dissolution
description: Presses against armour until the armour stops being armour.

name: Subsumed
description: Goes quiet and turns its whole shapeless attention on one of them, then folds forward over that spot.

name: Stoneshear
description: Brings one slab of an arm down in a single unhurried motion that does not need to be fast.

name: Tremor
description: Strikes the floor once, and the floor carries it to everyone standing on it.

name: Grinding Weight
description: Leans in and bears down, and plate gives way the way soft ground does under a millstone.

name: Sealing Blow
description: Draws back and holds there, weight gathered over one of them, for as long as it takes.

name: Withering Touch
description: Lays one dry hand on whatever is nearest and takes the years out of it.

name: Grave Wind
description: A cold draught out of somewhere deeper passes through the whole party at once.

name: Hollow Sight
description: Meets someone's eyes, and afterwards they cannot be sure where anything in the room is.

name: Name Struck Out
description: Regards one of them without moving, the way a clerk regards a line about to be crossed through.
